title: feat(plugin-list): Filter, Sort and Display as icon buttons with count badges on every list
body:
Fixes #12695
Clause-②: no

## What changed

**Targets 1 and 2: one icon shape on every list.** The list toolbar draws Filter, Sort and Display as 28 px icon buttons (`h-7 min-w-7 px-1.5 gap-1`) with no visible label at any width. Filter is now a funnel (`Funnel`), Sort keeps its up-and-down arrows (`ArrowUpDown`), and Display takes the sliders (`SlidersHorizontal`) that Filter used to draw. Its `Settings2` gear is gone. All three icons ship with lucide-react. Each count badge stays beside its icon and is the only text in the tool cluster. The search icon, the `+` and the popovers are unchanged, and Sort still hides below `sm` as before. The triggers live in `ListView` and `ViewSettingsPopover`, which app object lists, Setup `sys_*` lists and related lists all mount, so no prop, per-surface variant or view-count gate was added. Filter and Sort take the same shape under `compactToolbar: false`, because those buttons are shared; the other buttons that posture draws are unchanged.

**Target 3: accessible names unchanged.** `getByRole('button', { name: 'Filter' })`, `{ name: 'Sort' }` and `{ name: 'Display' }` resolve, and the active-filter name (`list.filterActive`, objectui#12500) is as before. Every icon-only trigger carries `aria-label` and `title` from its existing label key: Sort gains both from `list.sort`, Filter gains `title` from `list.filter`, and Display already had both from `list.display`. No new i18n keys. On main, with a sort applied, Sort was named by its label plus the badge ("Sort 1"), so `{ name: 'Sort' }` did not resolve in the live app. It now resolves at every width.

**Target 4: not taken.** The card lands icon-only, as the readings below show.

## Measured in HotCRM

DOM read at capture (`measurements.json` on the evidence branch). Cluster = the toolbar's `data-print-hide` group, including the search icon.

| Surface | Width | main | this PR | Names on this PR (Filter / Sort / Display) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accounts, 2 filters + 1 sort | 1024 | 320 px | 158 px | Filter, 2 active / Sort / Display |
| Accounts, 2 filters + 1 sort | 1280 | 320 px | 158 px | Filter, 2 active / Sort / Display |
| Setup › Approval Requests (view sort 1) | 1024 | 292 px | 138 px | Filter / Sort / Display |
| Setup › Approval Requests (view sort 1) | 1280 | 292 px | 138 px | Filter / Sort / Display |

Light and dark give the same widths. Each trigger measures 28 px alone and 48 px with a badge. On Accounts at 1280 px the view strip folds to "2 more" instead of main's "3 more". On main, Playwright's `getByRole('button', { name: 'Sort', exact: true })` finds nothing with a sort applied; on this PR it finds one button on every capture.

## Tests (head `5d0d2ea`)

- New `ListView.toolbarIconButtons-12695.test.tsx` has five cases:
  - wide: no label text, names resolve by role, `title` on each;
  - narrow: Filter and Display draw no label and keep their names;
  - badges: Filter 2 · Sort 1 · Display 2, and the cluster's whole text is the three counts;
  - `compactToolbar: false`: Filter and Sort keep the same shape;
  - CONTROL: each popover still opens from its icon button.
- Updated pins, each because it asserted the visible label this card retires:
  - `ListView.toolbarAccessibleNames-12500` › "CONTROL, wide": Filter's text is now empty instead of `Filter`.
  - `ObjectView.listUrlState-11860` › "CONTROL: opening and closing a panel leaves the URL unchanged": it now finds Filter by its name instead of its text.
- Ablations: each new or updated pin was mutated once and went red, and each restore proved an empty `git diff HEAD`. The mutations:
  - Sort label span re-added;
  - an unconditional Filter label;
  - Sort's `aria-label` and `title` deleted;
  - Filter's `title` deleted;
  - Display badge miscounted;
  - Filter's `aria-label` deleted (11860 pin);
  - Filter label span re-added (12500 pin).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list test`: exit 0, 143 files, 1487 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`: exit 0, 1477 files passed and 1 skipped; 13908 tests passed and 9 skipped.
- `type-check` (plugin-list, and app-shell's test tsconfig), `build` (plugin-list) and eslint on the touched files: exit 0.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check-changeset-presence` and `check:new-line-citations`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The card estimated about 260 px for main's cluster at 1024 px. Measured with badges showing, it is 320 px on Accounts and 292 px on Approval Requests, and this PR takes them to 158 px and 138 px.
- The "N more" view fold (objectui#12440), the console page header (objectui#12705) and the record page (objectui#12701) are out of scope and untouched.
